check_op_in_lagging_db: check if a PyTorch opinfo belongs to the functorch lagging op database using in_functorch_lagging_op_db
filter_op_db_for_functorch: filter PyTorch's op_db to get only the functorch lagging operations via functorch_lagging_op_db
inspect_lagging_meta_set: inspect the _functorch_lagging_meta set to see which op name and variant tuples are tracked
regenerate_lagging_op_db: regenerate the functorch_lagging_op_db.py file by running codegen/gen_functorch_lagging_op_db.py
add_op_to_lagging_db: add a new op name and variant tuple to _functorch_lagging_meta to include it in the lagging op database
